surface_name: Personal access token scopes and bases
title: Airtable returns 403 INVALID_PERMISSIONS_OR_MODEL_NOT_FOUND with a valid personal access token
symptoms: Invalid permissions, or the requested model was not found
Same token works on one base and fails on another
cause: A personal access token needs both the right scope (such as data.records:write) and the base added as a resource, and it can never do more than its creator can in that base. Missing either one looks the same as a wrong base or table ID.
fix: Edit the token, add the base under Access and the needed scopes, and confirm the creator has editor access. On Enterprise, check whether admins block API access to organization-owned bases.
apply: https://airtable.com/create/tokens > edit the token > add scopes data.records:read and data.records:write > add the target base as a resource > save
affected: Airtable Web API, personal access tokens, as of 2026-10
